business_scope.primary_industry_name: Carbon-Fiber Milling and Brushless Motor Integration of FPV Drones

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (single unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate tax variation)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (continental European tradition) with commercial codification under Decreto 410 de 1971 (Código de Comercio) and special S.A.S. statute Ley 1258 de 2008
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)
Pacific Alliance Additional Protocol with Mexico, Chile and Peru (in force 2016)
DTAAs with Spain (2008), Chile (2007), Mexico (2012), Canada (2023), South Korea, Switzerland and India
Colombia–UK, Colombia–Netherlands and Colombia–Germany Bilateral Investment Treaties

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006; Ley 1621 de 2013 (AML reform); Ley 2010 de 2019 Article 292, Decreto Reglamentario 830 de 2021 and Ley 52 de 2023 on the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB); Circular Externa 025 de 2019 of the Superintendencia de Sociedades; Hague Apostille Convention ratified by Law 1010 de 2012 and implemented via Decreto 1067 de 2015; Foreign Ministry Resolution 8903 de 2018 on apostille and consular legalization fees.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation) of any foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio of the shareholder's domicile in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via the Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores (of the shareholder's home country)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) of each foreign Ultimate Beneficial Owner in favor of local incorporator/counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the UBO's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization at the competent Colombian Consulate if the origin country is not a Hague Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport or national ID of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent registrar in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via the designated competent authority of the origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificado de Antecedentes Judiciales (judicial background certificate) of the appointing legal representative if a foreign resident
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent police or judicial authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization requiring sworn translation into Spanish

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory negative screening of all shareholders, legal representatives and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU financial restrictive measures, and Colombian domestic sanctions and UIAF intelligence records relating to organized crime drug trafficking and FARC/ELN financing under Ley 1621 de 2013. Any domestic or foreign Politically Exposed Person (PEP) triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification and senior management approval. The screening results must be archived in the pre-incorporation compliance file and presented to the Cámara de Comercio upon request.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social), operated under the portal www.rues.org.co by Confecámaras and the network of territorial Cámaras de Comercio; primary name availability search conducted at the local Cámara de Comercio of the registered office (homonimia study).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be expressed in Spanish or in any world language transliterated into the Latin/Spanish alphabet; non-Latin scripts (e.g., Cyrillic, Chinese, Arabic) are not admissible in the registry denomination unless a registered trademark is produced. The legal name must bear the 'S.A.S.' type suffix, and the deliberative part of the name cannot be identical or phonetically equivalent to an existing registered business name under the homonimia rules. Terms in foreign languages are evaluated by their Spanish phonetic rendering.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Institución Financiera, Fondo de Inversión, Sociedad Fiduciaria, Compañía de Seguros, Caja de Compensación (require prior authorization from Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
Cooperativa, Asociación Mutualista (require prior authorization from Superintendencia de Economía Solidaria)
Nacional, Presidencia, Gobierno, República (require prior authorization from the relevant ministry under Article 33 Código de Comercio)
Petróleos, Petroquímica, Minas, Hidrocarburos (require prior authorization from the Ministry of Mines and Energy or ANH/ANM)
Universidad, Colegio, Escuela (require prior approval from the Ministry of Education)
Clube o Centro Médico, IPS (require authorization from the Ministry of Health)
Bogotá, Colombia, Medellín and other official geographic denominations (restricted and require corresponding administrative consent where a false linkage to official bodies could be inferred)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 10 business days of receiving the homonimia rejection notice, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición before the same Cámara de Comercio, attaching trademark registrations, ministerial authorizations or evidence of non-identity; if the rejection is upheld, a recurso de apelación may be lodged with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within 5 business days. The 30-day name reservation may be renewed against payment of the current tariff, and a fresh homonimia application can be filed at any time without prejudice. All filings are processed through the RUES portal and the case will be resolved on the basis of Article 33 of Decreto 410 de 1971 and the SIC's administrative procedure rules.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible solely as the contractual and correspondence domicile for the receipt of legal notifications in the city of incorporation, but it does not satisfy the requirement of a verifiable establishment for the physical carbon-fiber milling and drone assembly operations. A physical address must be disclosed to the Cámara de Comercio and the SIC as the effective production establishment; PayPal and Stripe underwriting will independently require a demonstrable physical business address, bank account and operating history.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspections: 10-15% in the first year; the Superintendencia de Sociedades under Ley 1258 de 2008 and the SIC under consumer-protection and product-safety statutes (drones) retain discretionary inspection rights, while a predominantly e-commerce retail model using third-party logistics lowers the likelihood to the lower end of this band.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local chamber of commerce)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory sliding-scale tariff per Article 21 of Ley 1258 de 2008 and Decreto 1074 de 2015; minimum registration bracket applicable to a no-minimum-capital S.A.S.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Ley 1258 de 2008) on Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas, Articles 1-47; supplemented by the Código de Comercio (Decree 410 of 1971), Articles 98-158; implementing rules of the Superintendencia de Sociedades and Decree 1074 of 2015 (RUES regulations)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's registered office territory (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) portal; registrations filed electronically or physically at the Chamber's Registro Mercantil window
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (private incorporation deed executed by shareholders, with signatures authenticated by a notary or the Chamber, delivered for registration via RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital required under Ley 1258/2008, Art. 5. Capital is freely determined in the bylaws and may be paid at subscription, deferred up to two years, or paid in installments; no escrow or bank deposit certificate is required for incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST SHAREHOLDER RESOLUTION No. 1 — [COMPANY] S.A.S. The sole shareholder, subscriber of 100% of the authorized capital, hereby resolves: (1) the Company is validly incorporated as a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada under Ley 1258 de 2008; (2) the subscribed shares are accepted, issued, and fully allocated per the incorporation deed; (3) the registered office is fixed at Calle Ficticia # 12-23, Bogotá D.C., Colombia; (4) Juan P. Example is elected Gerente General and legal representative with full corporate powers; (5) Diana R. Example is elected Subgerente Suplente; (6) all corporate books are approved and delivered; (7) the incorporation instrument is ratified and its registration before the Cámara de Comercio, DIAN, and RUES is authorized.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of intended domicile via RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File up to three proposed company names in the RUES homonym check module; the system validates against the Registro Mercantil database. Upon approval, a name certificate is issued valid for 30 calendar days during which incorporation must be filed. Use the approved name verbatim in the bylaws.
required_dossiers: DNI or passport of the requesting shareholder
Completed RUES name-preference form with up to 3 names
Certificate of territorial jurisdiction of the registered office (if available)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity, file alternative preferences or submit a written request to the Chamber's Registro Mercantil for reassessment; if wrongly matched, request cancellation of the conflicting registration through the RUES correction procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration of RUT with the national tax authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) via www.dian.gov.co, virtual or physical service points
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete DIAN's inscription request for a provisional RUT under the corporate entity classification before final Chamber registration. This assigns a provisional tax ID (pre-RUT- número de preinscripción) which will be required as a supporting document in the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Valid ID of the legal representative designee
Proof of address of the corporate domicile
RUT registration form (Formulario de inscripción) filled online
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the pre-RUT is queried or rejected, correct the recorded KYC data in the DIAN system (solicitud de corrección de datos) and resubmit; escalate via DIAN's virtual assistance or a physical appointment with supporting proof.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the private incorporation deed (documento privado de constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public for signature authentication or Cámara de Comercio for recognition of private signatures; alternatively digital signature via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the comprehensive bylaws in Spanish, including share classes, capital, term, administration (Gerente), audit rules, and shareholder rights. Authenticate the signatures of all shareholders; if executed privately, the deed must be presented for signature recognition before the Chamber. Must be completed before the 30-day name certificate expires.
required_dossiers: Authenticated private incorporation deed with full bylaws
Valid ID of each subscribing shareholder or power of attorney (with apostille for foreign entities)
Pre-RUT of the company
Name approval certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary or Chamber finds drafting defects, execute a clarificatory document (aclaración o ratificación) signed by all shareholders and re-authenticate; re-establish the name if the certificate lapsed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry filing before the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio competent for the registered office; RUES electronic filing or Chamber Registry counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the executed deed with the pre-RUT, pay the inscription and book-legalization fees, and submit the documentation. The Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal Mercantil and registers the company in the Mercantile Registry. This completion activates the company's legal personality.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation deed with authenticated signatures
Pre-RUT certificate
ID and power of attorney of the representative submitting the filing
Chamber fee receipt (generated at payment)
Company seal (optional at this stage)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon deficiency notification, the applicant is granted 5 business days to cure documents; if registration is erroneously rejected, appeal to the Superintendencia de Sociedades or request voiding of the Chamber's adverse decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT activation and employer social-assurance registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN for RUT; Caja de Compensación Familiar and ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) of the employer's election
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the Certificate of Existence into DIAN's portal to convert the pre-RUT into a definitive RUT with the assigned NIT. Simultaneously register the company as an employer with the Caja de Compensación Familiar, an ARL, an EPS, and a pension fund administrator, as required before hiring.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Bylaws and identified legal representative
NIT definitively assigned
Employer registration forms of each assurance entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN does not activate the RUT, submit a request for physical inspection of the establishment (verificación) or file a rectification notice in DIAN's virtual channel; if assurance portals reject the registration, re-submit with the corresponding affiliation template and chamber certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate bank account opening and land-use certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank supervised by Superintendencia Financiera; municipal Secretaría de Planeación for the Certificado de Uso de Suelo
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate bank account in the company's own name by presenting the NIT, Certificate of Existence, and representative's ID. Additionally, request the municipal land-use certificate from the planning office to validate lawful industrial/commercial operation at the registered physical address.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
NIT
Corporate bylaws
ID of legal representative and other signatories
Proof of registered office address
Certificado de Uso de Suelo application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank returns the KYC dossier, correct any discrepancy in the representative authorization or constitution data and resubmit; unreasonably prolonged rejections may be escalated to the Superintendencia Financiera's consumer-protection channels.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial de Aeronáutica Civil (UAEAC) — Registro Nacional de RPAS; municipal Secretaría de Planeación for land-use certification; Cámara de Comercio registry for the mercantile establishment license
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Aeronave Pilotada a Distancia (Registro RPAS/Fabricante) and Certificado de Uso de Suelo / Licencia de Funcionamiento Industrial del establecimiento (municipal industrial operation permit)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and/or regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (e.g., Corporación Autónoma Regional de Cundinamarca — CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — EIA not required; mandatory Registro de Actividades de Bajo Impacto and Registro de Generadores de Residuos Peligrosos under Decree 4741 of 2005; an atmospheric emission registration is required for carbon-fiber milling and resin curing areas
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: PM2.5 ambient limit ≤ 50 µg/m³ (24-hour average, Res. 2254/2017); VOCs and particulate stack discharge must comply with Res. 909/2008 limits (e.g., dust ≤ 150 mg/m³; VOC thresholds per process); industrial wastewater discharges must meet pH 6.0-9.0, TSS ≤ 100 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 200 mg/L under Res. 0631/2015; hazardous waste (resin, carbon-fiber dust, solvent-contaminated wipes) must be labeled, stored ≤ 6 months, and disposed of through a licensed waste-management carrier
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos — Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Protección contra Incendios (fire extinguishers, non-obstructed egress, emergency lighting, fire alarm signage); municipal Gestión del Riesgo registration for disaster mitigation; Ministerio de Trabajo / ARL clearance — mandatory Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) program, machinery-guarding inspection for CNC mills, and respiratory-protection plan for carbon-fiber particulates

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia, the central bank of Colombia, acting jointly with the Comité de Cambios as the national foreign-exchange regulatory authority, and exercised operationally in the banking system through the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia for supervised intermediaries.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia applies a dual-regime convertibility model: current-account transactions are broadly free and remittable, while capital-account transactions require registration under the Colombian foreign-exchange framework. Dividends, royalties, and service fees may be remitted through the official exchange market after satisfying domestic income-tax withholding, statutory corporate reserves, transfer-pricing documentation, and any applicable annual reporting. Foreign direct investment must be registered with Banco de la República to secure legal repatriation rights; unregistered capital contributions are not eligible for free remittance. For an FPV drone trading and retail entity, proceeds from export sales and inbound onboarding capital are considered channelable through the official exchange market, whereas e-commerce collection via third-party platforms must be timely repatriated into a Colombian regulated account to comply with cash-flow timing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Colombian exchange regulatory framework, exporters must channel export proceeds through the official exchange market via an authorized local commercial bank and file the corresponding exchange declaration (declaración de cambio). The statutory timeline requires the foreign currency to be channeled and settled within six months counted from the date of receipt or release of the funds by the collection entity. There is no fixed mandatory conversion ratio to Colombian pesos at the central-bank level; instead, 100 percent of export-derived foreign currency is required to pass through the authorized FX market and must be declared, with the exporter permitted to maintain foreign-currency balances only in accounts expressly authorized by the central bank. Failure to channel within the six-month window creates exchange infraction liability enforceable by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cross-border digital EMI platforms are not licensed deposit-taking institutions in Colombia and cannot serve as a sovereign-regulated treasury account for the Colombian S.A.S. Their legal usefulness is restricted to supplementary collection wallets positioned outside Colombia, not as the primary bank account destination for export proceeds. Feasibility rating: Low as a primary corporate treasury rail; Medium as a supplementary multicurrency receivable tool only where funds are subsequently settled into a Colombian authorized FX intermediary.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian commercial banks uniformly apply a strict physical-presence mandate for a non-resident leveraged or newly registered S.A.S. At minimum, the local legal representative must appear in person before the compliance officer with original identification and corporate authorization; the controlling foreign shareholder is commonly required to appear at least once or to complete an enhanced-remote identity verification recognized by the local bank. Purely remote account opening is available only on an exceptional, low-risk express current-account basis, and for an FPV drone trading entity with third-party e-commerce proceeds, in-person KYC is effectively mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder lacking a verifiable Colombian tax ID and credible current banking relationship.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport, home-country corporate extract, certificate of good standing, verifying auditor or home-bank reference letter, source-of-funds declaration for the FPV drone venture, corporate authorization minutes, and notarized documentation authorizing the local representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Classic single-shareholder S.A.S. without commercial substance or with passive nominee management.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered estatutos, RUT certificate, minutes appointing the local legal representative, formal office-service or warehouse address, supply and distribution agreements for FPV drones, supplier invoices, customs import records, and evidence of business correspondence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disproportionate volumes of small-value, third-party e-commerce payments received through PayPal or Stripe from global retail end-customers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment-service provider agreements, merchant KYC and identity records, consolidated transaction dashboard, refund-and-chargeback reconciliation, IP address and shipping data supporting the reduced-risk retail profile, consumer terms of sale, and anti-money-laundering policy aligned with Colombian purchaser verification rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export-related foreign-currency proceeds received without timely exchange declaration through the official market.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices, customs export declarations and transport documents, vendor or consignee final-contract evidence, SWIFT MT103 inward-credit instructions, bank statement showing creditor-beneficiary details, and the exchange declaration form proving the proceeds were canalized within the six-month window.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Apparent UBO connection to a country outside Colombian banking white-list correspondence or involved in sanctioned-country routing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed UBO and indirect-shareholding diagram, AML/KYC certifications from the upstream home-country bank, a country-risk rationale, commercially verifiable end-customer base, availability of trade documents, and engagement of an in-country compliance advisor acceptable to the bank's risk committee.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident capital injections must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank into a Colombian local current account held at an authorized foreign-exchange intermediary. The wire instruction must cite the Colombian S.A.S. beneficiary NIT, include the invoice or subscription intent, and describe the purpose as 'Foreign Direct Investment – Capital Contribution' in compliance with the exchange declaration framework. Upon receipt, the bank files the applicable declaración de cambio (typically Form 2) and credits the funds to the capital escrow account; the shares and foreign-investment certificate are registered in local corporate records before any operational disbursement can occur.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for carbon-fiber milling equipment, brushless motors, and component import settlements use SWIFT MT103 direct transfers and documentary commercial letters of credit issued under UCP600 for larger, recurring counterparties. USD and EUR clearings are routed through the bank's international correspondent network via Fedwire, CHIPS, and TARGET2; Colombian peso disbursements are cleared through the local large-value settlement infrastructure administered by Banco de la República. All outward trade payments are matched against the import declaration, supplier commercial documents, and a corresponding exchange declaration when conversion of COP into a foreign currency is required. The bank reviews the underlying trade contract, drains jurisdictional fat-finger risks through designated anti-fraud controls, and records every foreign-currency clearing event for central-bank statistics.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla Colombian Peso / U.S. Dollar OTC forwards executed with an authorized local bank or registered financial intermediary.
Non-deliverable forwards referencing the official TRM and underlying commercial or financial flows with non-resident counterparties.
Plain-vanilla Colombian Peso / U.S. Dollar cross-currency swaps used to manage long-term dual-currency liquidity exposure.
Exchange-rate options and collars traded under authorizations established for transaction-driven hedging and only with supervised intermediaries having Banco de la República FX-license status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual renewal of the commercial registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio / Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year no later than 31 March, covering the prior commercial year; the standard chamber window is 1 January–31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a surcharge calculated over net assets (generally 2% for the first month plus 0.2% monthly thereafter, depending on the chamber), daily statutory interest, and, after one year of delinquency, cancellation of registration and automatic strike-off of the legal entity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income and complementary tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal-year return due under the DIAN annual calendar for legal entities, usually between 9 September and 10 October of the following year; exact dates depend on the last digit of the NIT.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing carries a penalty of 5% of net tax due per month or fraction (capped at 100% of tax), a minimum of 10 UVT when there is no tax to pay, plus daily default interest of around 1.91% per month (DIAN rate) and suspension of the RUT and foreign-trade authorizations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Reporte Anual de Beneficiario Final (annual final-beneficial-owner declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual window generally from 1 February through 30 April after the fiscal year-end, or within 30 calendar days after any qualifying shareholding change; exact deadline follows DIAN’s issued calendar by NIT digit.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update attracts sanction under DIAN Resolution 164/2021 and Tax Code Article 651, which may exceed COP 400 million (approx. USD 100,000) per report for the entity and personal fines for the legal representative; repeat/default conduct may lead to tax-credit freezing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory auditor for an SAS unless (i) gross assets of the previous year exceeded 3,000 current SMMLV, (ii) gross revenues of the previous year exceeded 3,000 SMMLV, or (iii) activities are subject to a supervisory authority. The racing-drone retail company below those thresholds may operate without an audited revisor fiscal, though shareholders may appoint a revisor fiscal voluntarily in the bylaws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards for SMEs (NIIF/NIC for SMEs, Group 2) under DUR 2420 of 2015, supplemented by the Código de Comercio and DIAN procedural rules; full IFRS is required only if the entity qualifies as a large Group-1 company.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: In each calendar year the SAS must confirm in the DIAN annual report the list of final beneficial owners holding directly or indirectly more than 10% of capital or voting rights, or exercising control through other means. The confirmation is required even where there are no share transfers; any share transfer that changes the final-beneficiary list must be reported within 30 calendar days, before the next annual cycle, on the official DIAN form (Formulario 300 y 350 / RUBF).
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Registro de Accionistas (shareholders register showing each issuance and transfer)
Libro de Actas de la Asamblea General de Accionistas (minutes of annual and extraordinary shareholder meetings)
Libro de Asistencia a la Asamblea General (attendance record)
Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva, if a board of directors has been established
Libro de Actas de la Reunión de Socios
Corporate documents file: bylaws, capital modifications, powers of attorney and transfer deeds

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450–1,200 per annum (registered office in Bogotá and legal representation; may include document translation and apostille)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200–4,000 per annum for a certified local accountant or independent auditor if the SAS voluntarily opts for an audit or crosses the 3,000 SMMLV threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday applies to FPV racing drone manufacturing. A Colombian S.A.S. may claim the additional income tax deduction of 25% for investments in science, technology, and innovation under Article 158-1 E.T.; a 20% rate applies only in authorized Zonas Francas. Ordinary manufacturing and retail of carbon-fiber FPV components and brushless motors are taxable at the 35% general rate.
